ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to <5% of the total surface area, primarily localized at the distal tips and scattered circular scar sites.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity pigmentation across 95% of both lobes; high-contrast circular white rings (approx. 10-15 pixels in diameter) distributed sporadically across the mid-lobed regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 75-degree angle of divergence at the central lobar junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-5 pixel depth) across 80% of the trailing edge, becoming highly irregular and textured at the distal tips due to biological colonization.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a linear taper toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Six distinct circular white ring clusters on the right lobe (upper quadrant) and three on the left lobe (lower quadrant), corresponding to old barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, high-relief white calcified clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; several circular 'donut' scars on the right lobe dorsal-ventral surface.
